-- Phase 1: declarations and signatures for read_note.

-- True only for a bare file name: no path separators, not "." or "..",
-- and not empty. Anything else is rejected before any file is opened.
is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool =
  pre name.char_count() >= 0
  post out == False or name.char_count() > 0
  ex is_plain_name("a.txt") == True
  ex is_plain_name("../secret") == False
  if name == "" or name == "." or name == ".."
    return False
  if name.split("/").len() > 1 or name.split("\\").len() > 1
    return False
  True

-- Returns the text of notes/name. A name that is not plain, a missing
-- file, or an unreadable file gives "". The body narrows fs to the
-- notes directory with `with fs = fs.sub("notes")` before reading.
read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs =
  pre name.char_count() >= 0
  post out.char_count() >= 0
  ex read_note("missing.txt") == ""
  ex read_note("../secret") == ""
  if is_plain_name(name) == False
    return ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    let text = fs.read(name) else ""
    return text
